steps.title: Dig out a room
steps.hint: Select Dig in the Build tab and drag across earth tiles. Your imps will excavate them.

steps.title: Expand your territory
steps.hint: Imps claim dug floor connected to your dungeon. Keep digging until your domain grows.

steps.title: Build a Lair
steps.hint: Select Lair in the Build tab and drag over claimed floor. Creatures need somewhere to sleep.

steps.title: Build a Hatchery
steps.hint: Select Hatchery and place it on claimed floor. It feeds your creatures.

steps.title: Build a Treasury
steps.hint: Select Treasury to store more gold. Dig into gold veins to fill it.

steps.title: Recruit a creature
steps.hint: With a lair and hatchery ready, creatures will join your dungeon. Prepare defenses before the heroes arrive.

steps.title: Survive a skirmish
steps.hint: Let your creatures meet a hostile and win your first fight.

steps.title: Arm a trap
steps.hint: Use the Traps tab to build a trap and let an invading hero trigger it.

steps.title: Keep the dungeon paid
steps.hint: Payday arrives on the simulation clock. Keep gold in reserve so moods and loyalty hold.

steps.title: Research an upgrade
steps.hint: Open the Research tab, choose a technology, and let your scholars finish it.

steps.title: Face the first hero wave
steps.hint: Hold the heart through the first organized assault. Traps, rooms, and creature moods all matter.

steps.title: Cast a spell
steps.hint: Choose a spell in the Magic tab and tap a valid tile or target.

steps.title: Turn a hero
steps.hint: Capture a fallen hero and complete a prison or torture-chamber conversion.

steps.title: Use the temple
steps.hint: Build a Temple and learn how its dark rite changes the dungeon's mana economy.
